findings.finding: The prior CI gate validated 1500/72/42/36 declarations but did not construct or prove the matrix.
findings.resolution: Added a deterministic generator plus frozen 42-row strength-2 template; generation now proves 1500 exact rows, 16,011/16,011 pair obligations and 330/330 targeted 3-wise obligations.

findings.finding: Pairwise acceptance allowed conceptual exclusions but had no machine authority for exclusions or reason codes.
findings.resolution: Added combinatorial-legal-pair-constraints.json with explicit anti-gaming policy, reason-code registry, all 27 process bindings and current strongest closure of zero exclusions.

findings.finding: The prose 3-wise examples referenced operatingCase, transientState, upstreamEvidenceState and reserve/capacity factors that were not members of the frozen eight-factor model.
findings.resolution: Reconciled the plan to five exact families using only declared factors and froze T3-001..T3-030 in combinatorial-targeted-three-wise.json for all 11 priority processes.

findings.finding: The 36 system-wide scenarios were prose-only and could be replaced by arbitrary filler while preserving the count.
findings.resolution: Added combinatorial-system-wide-inventory.json with exact SYS-001..SYS-036 identities and required package ownership.

findings.finding: The authority manifest did not fingerprint the legal-pair registry, 3-wise inventory, covering template, system-wide inventory or actual generator source.
findings.resolution: Authority manifest generation now fingerprints all combinatorial authorities, generator source and fifth-pass audit artifacts.

findings.finding: Main P8/P9 closure language predated constructive pairwise/3-wise generation and relied on a later amendment for the 1500-case layer.
findings.resolution: P8/P9 are synchronized to require generated exact-head combinatorial evidence in addition to the normative amendment.

findings.finding: The declaration-only CI step emitted no 1500-row artifact and therefore could not bind a matrix fingerprint to the exact authority fingerprint.
findings.resolution: CI now generates the authority manifest first, then generates/publishes the 1500-case artifact using that exact manifest fingerprint.

findings.finding: A deterministic-generation claim could drift if generator source changed without participating in authority identity.
findings.resolution: The generator source SHA-256 is an explicit authority-manifest field; a generator change invalidates the authority fingerprint and exact-head closure.
